network_intelligence.intended_use: Optional, user-declared inventory context for routers, switches, servers, access points and local compute devices that support AI HOME infrastructure.

intended_spatial_use: Advisory indoor room layout, obstacle and spatial-change context.
planned_spatial_tasks: Spatial change records with provenance and timestamps
limitations_and_safety_boundaries: Geometry does not identify fire, gas, electrical, structural or health hazards.
Network topology diagrams do not prove device reachability, availability, security or correct configuration.
No emergency response or home-safety guarantee.
Privacy-preserving local processing and sensor permissions require separate review.
Network inventories and topology diagrams are sensitive infrastructure data and must not be published without owner approval.
evidence_status: Shared Core network topology implementation and its CI workflow are merged and passing. AI HOME runtime adoption, real sensor integration, accuracy, field validation and certification are not established.
cost_policy: standard-library-first; no paid APIs, cloud GPU, automatic dependency installation, model downloads or hardware purchases
